name: tamra
description: Tamra knowledge base for Claude Code: connects the Tamra MCP server and adds /tamra:search, /tamra:save, /tamra:get and /tamra:update.

server_url.title: Tamra MCP URL
server_url.description: MCP endpoint of the Tamra API, e.g. http://localhost:5080/mcp on the machine running the Docker stack, or the HTTPS URL of a shared server.

token.title: Tamra agent token
token.description: Personal access token (kbp_...) from `kb token create` or `kb bootstrap-dev`. Stored in the secure credential store.
